parent_center.name: Access For Special Kids (ASK) Resource Center
parent_center.checked: Verified via parentcenterhub.org. Located at 5665 Greendale Rd, Suite D, Johnston, IA 50131. Phone: (515) 243-1713 or (800) 450-8667.

note: Iowa's Part C program is called Early ACCESS and is a partnership between Iowa Departments of Education, Public Health, Human Services, and University of Iowa Child Health Specialty Clinics. ASK Resource Center serves the entire state.
